info.title: OwlMail HTTP API
info.summary: Versioned OwlMail mailbox, relay, settings, and operational API
info.description: The contract for OwlMail's native `/api/v1` interface. Unversioned MailDev-style compatibility routes are intentionally excluded because their protocol behavior is not an exact MailDev contract. Configure `-base-pathname` (or `OWLMAIL_BASE_PATHNAME`) to place the server and this contract below a reverse-proxy prefix. The served documents rewrite the relative server URL to include that prefix. HTTP Basic authentication is optional at deployment time; when enabled it protects every operation except liveness and readiness. The unversioned `/healthz` and `/readyz` probes are also public but remain outside this versioned contract.

post.description: Returns 202 after OwlMail creates a queryable relay job. Poll the returned statusUrl until the job is succeeded or failed; failed jobs expose only a bounded error category. Explicit recipients are limited to 1024 UTF-8 bytes. If all 1000 status slots contain active or newly completed protected jobs, the request returns 503 with Retry-After instead of evicting them.

Reads the cached attachment-store health and never performs a synchronous S3 request. Responses expose only safe categories. This endpoint is unauthenticated, but when Basic Auth deployment middleware is active, a browser request with a foreign `Origin` is rejected with a plain-text 403 before reaching this handler.

503.description: An enabled dependency is checking or unavailable.

get.summary: Upgrade to the native WebSocket protocol
get.description: Send an RFC 6455 upgrade request. This is not Socket.IO. After upgrade the server first emits `connected`; clients may send `ping` and receive `pong`; mailbox events are `new` and `delete`. When Basic Auth is enabled, browser upgrades must also use OwlMail's own Origin.

400.description: Invalid RFC 6455 upgrade headers or handshake key.

get.description: Returns the current state of one process-local relay job. Completed jobs expire after 24 hours, but the 1000-job capacity may evict them earlier after a one-minute post-completion protection window. Active jobs are never evicted.

basicAuth.description: Deployment-conditional HTTP Basic Auth. When server credentials are configured, callers must supply matching credentials; rejected requests receive a plain-text 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="OwlMail"`.

EmailID.name: id
EmailID.description: Eight-character OwlMail ID or UUID, depending on server configuration.

AttachmentFilename.name: filename
AttachmentFilename.description: The attachment's generated filename from the email metadata.

RelayTo.name: relayTo
RelayTo.description: Explicit downstream recipient. The value is passed to asynchronous relay handling without API-layer syntax validation and is limited to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. Invalid values and values below 1 fall back to 50; values above 1000 are capped.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Zero-based number of matching records to skip. Invalid or negative values fall back to 0.

Search.name: q
Search.description: Case-insensitive substring search in subject, text, and HTML.

From.name: from
From.description: Case-insensitive substring match against sender name or address.

To.name: to
To.description: Case-insensitive substring match against To, CC, and calculated BCC recipients.

DateFrom.name: dateFrom
DateFrom.description: Inclusive UTC-naive calendar date lower boundary. Invalid values are ignored.

DateTo.name: dateTo
DateTo.description: Inclusive UTC-naive upper boundary at 00:00:00 of the following calendar date. Invalid values are ignored.

Read.name: read
Read.description: Read-state filter. Present values other than `true` are treated as false.

SortBy.name: sortBy
SortBy.description: Sort key. When omitted, results are sorted newest-first. Unsupported non-empty values preserve mailbox order.

SortOrder.name: sortOrder
SortOrder.description: Ascending or descending order for a supported sort key.

ExportIDs.name: ids
ExportIDs.description: Comma-separated IDs. When non-empty, takes precedence over filters.

Address.description: Address fields retain the capitalization produced by Go's mail.Address JSON encoding.

preview.description: Truncated after 200 UTF-8 bytes, not characters, with `...` appended when truncated.

relayTo.description: Optional explicit recipient, limited to 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Query `relayTo` takes precedence over this field.

NotFound.description: The email or file was not found.

Unauthorized.description: Basic Auth is enabled and credentials are missing or invalid. The body is plain text, not the JSON API error structure.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Present as `Basic realm="OwlMail"` when the Authorization header is missing.

Forbidden.description: When Basic Auth deployment middleware is enabled, the pre-authentication same-origin check rejected a browser request with a foreign `Origin`. A 403 does not imply successful authentication, and the body is plain text.
